english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone does something in an affected or unnatural manner.

examples.english: They laughed artificially twice, and everyone knew they were putting it on.
examples.traditional: 佢唔自然咁笑咗兩聲，成班人都知佢扮嘢。
